name: Sika SealTape B
paste:
SIKA® SEALTAPE B: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® SealTape B, December 2025, Version 03.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/6/sika-sealtape-b.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® SealTape B where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 03.01).
1.2 Product description. Self-adhesive waterproofing tape for flexible and waterproof of areas at risk of cracking (wall corners, floor-to-wall connections, pipelines etc.).
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Sealing together between wall/floor surfaces and other change of planes including shower niches in wet rooms such as bathrooms and showers
    - Sealing together between tile and slab surfaces on balconies, terraces and on façades
    - Waterproof terminations such as water stop angles.
    - Sealing of pipes and drains
    - System component for the SikaCeram Sealing membrane A
    - For use indoors and outdoors
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® SealTape B
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: A next generation hybrid self-adhesive sealing tape designed for use with water-based waterproofing membranes
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (December 2025, Version 03.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - DIN EN 1928: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Watertightness (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Compliant 490% lateral elongation
    - Contains PE Foil liner for 100% waterproofing protection
    - Multi component bandage for maximum protection
    - Non woven fleece than doesnt prevent elongation unlike other self adhesives butyl tapes
    - Highly Elastic
    - Simple to use / self adhesive
    - Compatable with SikaTile adhesives
    - Highly waterproof
    - Bonding well with the waterproofing compound
    - Very thin
    - Strong adhesion on a wide range of substrates
    - Waterproof
    - Bonds to PVC control leak flanges and metal channel drains without a primer.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Yellow, or grey
2.6 Composition. Sika® SealTape B
    | Backing tape | Release liner |
    | Sealing layer: | Polyethylene (PE Foil) |
    | Fleece: | Polyester (PES) non woven |
    | Adhesive: | Butyl |
2.7 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Flexural-strength: Breaking load Longitudinal: 49N / 15mm; Breaking load Lateral: 37N / 15mm; Peel Test on Neutral PVC carrier: .13N / 20mm; Burst pressure: 2.0 bar
    - Elongation: Elongation at break; Lateral: 490%; Longitudinal: 65%
    - Watertightness: > 1.5 bar (DIN EN 1928, Procedure B)
2.8 Length.
    | Sika® SealTape B | ~ 20 m |
2.9 Width.
    | Sika® SealTape B | ~ 100 mm |
2.10 Compatibility. Sika® SealTape B is suitable for use with the folowing Sika waterproofing products
    - SikaTile under tile waterproofing membranes
    - Sikalastic WPU
    - Sikalastic 1K
    - SikaCeram Sealing Membrane A
    - Davco under tile waterproofing membranes
2.11 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: In original, unopened, sealed and undamaged packaging: 12 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: Storage temperature between +5 °C and +30 °C. Store in dry conditions. Protect from direct sunlight.
2.12 Packaging.
    | Sika® SealTape B | Roll of 20 meters in a box |

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 03.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation.
    - The substrate must be secure, ready to take loads as well as free of oil, grease, dust and other separating layers.
    - A primer is recommended prior to application, refer the the specific instructions on the relevant product data sheet of the Sika waterproofing membrane. Priming of PVC control leak flanges and metal channel drains are not required. Apply the Sika® SealTape B directly onto the surface and use a small roller flatten and avoid air pockets.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 03.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Thickness: ~ 0.99 mm
4.3 Application method / tools.
    - Remove the Sika® SealTape B protective foil liner and stick to the dust-free substrate by applying pressure without prestressing. Immediately after this, the waterproofing compound. The tape must be incorporated into the waterproofing layer with the correct layer thickness. At splices and connection points, the tape must overlap by at least 4 cm.
    - The middle of the Sika® SealTape B requires no overcoating with the waterproofing membrane. The waterproofing membrane shall be applied to a minimum width of 25mm over the tape edges.
    - Internal, external corners, and pipe penetrations can be cut out of the Sika® SealTape B. Refer to the method statement located on the Sika Australia website. If Sika® SealTape B is bonded on top of the waterproofing layer, it must be overlayed with a coat of the selected waterproofing membrane.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations.
    - For sealing around pipes, drains and in corners, the tape must be cut to size accordingly.
    - Not suitable for pressurised water such as pools and spas use SikaSeal Tape F for these applications.
    - Use in conjunction with the relevant product data sheet for the selected Sika waterproofing membrane.
    - For uses not mentioned in this document contact SIka Australia.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Substrate temperature. in. +5°C, max. +35°C; Avoid applications in hot direct sun above 30°C
5.3 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Watertightness: > 1.5 bar (DIN EN 1928, Procedure B)
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® SealTape B, December 2025, Version 03.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/6/sika-sealtape-b.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
